** [[Hidden Stash]] * [[Gwen]] will not follow you into The Northlands. * The Charr are hostile towards ambient creatures (Warthogs) and Oakhearts. * Groups of Grawl Crones and Grawl Fighters used to be hostile only towards Charr, but are now friendly with Charr and hostile to other Grawl and Oakhearts. * Following the main path north, you will find a [[Piken Square (landmark)|small courtyard]]; after the Searing, this becomes [[Piken Square]], an [[outpost]] in [[the Breach]]. ** After completion of [[A Bastion In the North]] (in {{reforgedmode}}), [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]] can be accessed as an outpost in The Northlands. * The area is split into two sections: the original southern part, accessible from Lakeside County and the southern exit from the Piken Square outpost, and the northern part added during [[Guild Wars Reforged]], accessible from the northeast exit from Piken Square. ** Before completion of A Bastion In the North, or while either Across the Wall or A Bastion In the North is active, is is possible to walk through Piken Square without changing zone and enter the northern section. ** After completion of A Bastion In the North, the two sections can be traversed through one gate at the northern bridge and another in the eastern ruins, both guarded by Charr. {{bug|The Shrine near Piken Square's south exit isn't actually activated when leaving the outpost (but will appear activated). Since players dying will get teleported to the closest shrine, this can result in situations where players dying near the altar section get teleported at the north-eastern shrine, close to the Forsaken Tunnels' eastern entrance}} == Trivia == * Historically, it was necessary to have two players in the party in order to reach The Northlands (one to [[Gate monkey|open the gate]], another to run through it). This was changed in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20180606|June 6, 2018 update]], when the gate's timer was doubled, allowing a single player sufficient time to cross through from the lever before it closed. **In a later update, the timer was further increased, allowing even more leeway to go through the gate. * If you turn east from the road to [[Piken Square (landmark)|Piken Square]], you can travel to the site where [[Jaw Smokeskin]] will start [[The Searing]]. This altar is guarded by 30 Charr (including Smokeskin and three other bosses). However, killing them will not prevent the eventual cataclysm. * The charr have built several [[Titan]] effigies in the area. * As you approach the Shrine where the Searing is cast, the texture of the sky changes to dark red and purple, with heavy storm clouds visible (similar to how things look in post-searing [[Ascalon]]). * All of the Charr bosses also appear after the Searing in the [[Nolani Academy]] mission. * The post-Searing [[landmark]] for this part of pre-Searing includes a signpost that reads ''[[The Breach]]''. (However, the boundaries of the relevant explorable areas do not line up, e.g. [[The Great Northern Wall]] includes the east end of the pre-Searing zone.) * The [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401|April 1st, 2026 update]] added some additional ruined structures and extended the zone to the north, covering most of the playable area of [[the Great Northern Wall]] mission in post-Searing. {{Explorable areas in pre-Searing Ascalon}} [[de:Nordländer]]
